description: A fresh unanswered thread in English, the same report the other fixtures carry, told in the pipeline's home language. Detection identifies it as English by profile, the draft answers in English, `comment` is granted, and the run posts the first reply — the baseline the whole multilingual matrix is compared against.
warrant:
version: 1
labels:
  - name: bug
    description: Something that used to work and does not.
languages:
  - en
  - vi
  - zh
duties:
  respond: [comment]

thread.title: Dark mode is not saved after reloading the page
thread.body: Dark mode is not saved after reloading the page. I checked the settings but it always returns to the default every time I open the page. Please fix this.

draft-over.text: Thanks for the report — we will persist the dark mode choice to local storage so it survives a page reload.

expected.patch: Thanks for the report — we will persist the dark mode choice to local storage so it survives a page reload.
